doc.title: Diamond Pro-Am 9 ft gully ball return — channel class, trunk-tray, HEAD-end (emblem-end) collector (GULLY g1, D621 lane export)
doc.issue: #650 / GH-621 (ob-release GULLY ROUND 2 order, 2026-09-18; owner Fleet Steward ruling 23:36Z 09-17 option 2b)
sources: GULLY-R1.md (diamond lane, sha256 bd5a1b5f…64c3) §2-3 design (opening = the MODEL 560 x 98 slot; tray flush with the sill; seat line 35 mm inside the wall; first-nine-visible stop; capacity 15) — its §1 FOOT verdict is WITHDRAWN: GULLY-END-PHOTO.md (ballreturn lane, sha256 25fa5c9f…3537) reads Diamond's own install timelapse 24/25 + manning-body-ballreturn-16: the collector is under the DIAMOND emblem = the HEAD end (−x), where the model already put it

MFR topology: Diamond spec text as reproduced by an authorized dealer (https://valley-billiards.com/product/diamond-pro-am-pool-table/; its 'tail end' word is NOT the end evidence) + docs/geometry/diamond-proam-9ft-table-definition.json BR-01 (audit row D23; corrigendum row g1: end = HEAD/emblem at PHOTO tier)

MODEL: web/scene/table.js on diamond-variants-2026-09 (#644) — render.cabinet openings/recess/wall/lean, legSection + legStanceIn (EN-05), pocketCup (pool_trap01/03), bedAboveFloor 0.76812; main's return shaft bottom -0.2035 (returnshaft-<pt>) as the pocket exit
kernel cups: TABLE_SPECS.diamond_proam_9ft via table-in-node.mjs (corners +-1295.1/+-660.1 r 48.3, middles 0/+-690.6 r 50.8)
PHOTO-open: channel route / width / slope and the collector depth (no ruler in any frame: timelapse 640 x 360, manning 1280 x 720; BR-02 TO-BE-MEASURED, O3 open, O5 patents backlog)
doc.notes: The runtime flag (render.pocketSystem 'return-track' + render.returnTrack 'diamond_proam_9ft-gully' on diamond_proam_9ft; the measured twin pool_pro_9ft_measured follows by law) is the ball-return lane's companion after #644 — this file is inert data until it lands. Visible open-air travel: the fall and the first ~100 mm of every entry lie below the apron band outside the cabinet (the corner cups sit over the leg columns; no channel mesh is modelled) — a low outside camera sees the ball for ~0.15 s; a dark boot-spout stub is the furniture fix (F-tier). The 8 ft / 7 ft Pro-Am exports are revisions of this file with their own reads.

axes.+Z: left to right viewed from head rail

datum_frame.runtime_mapping: three.js (x, y, z) = (X, Y, Z) x 0.001; kernel (kx, ky, kz) = (Z, X, Y) x 0.001
datum_frame.pocket_order: kernel order: 0 lb, 1 lc, 2 lt, 3 rb, 4 rc, 5 rt (l/r = sign of Z, b/c/t = -X / 0 / +X)

provenance.source: WPA Equipment Specifications §16, 2 1/4 in pool ball (crates/pool-core default r 0.028575)

channel floor width = ball 57.15 + 2 x 6.4 mm clearance (the real rubber-lined channel width is PHOTO-open: BR-02 / O3; MFR text: 'Rubber Lined to protect the balls from end to end'); support line = the floor centreline, h = r, rho = r, k = 5/7

PROXY: the kernel default class (params.rs ClothPreset::default, u_r 0.010) stands in for the unmeasured rubber-channel class (schema: an OPEN research item); every non-tray edge drains with tan >= 0.021 > 1.4 x 0.010

research.md R5 / the brief's 'inelastic arrival' and the owner's 「一个接一个堆」: arriving balls share a common velocity with the group they touch, the tray wall is infinite mass. A modelling decision, NOT a measurement.
